wish: someone should make an app that keeps your medical information in one form you can hand to your doctor
spec:
Keeps name, allergies, conditions, medications, surgeries and an emergency contact in one form on this device.
Type into the fields and add list items; the one-page summary above updates and prints or saves as PDF to hand to a doctor.
Does not send anything anywhere, check interactions or give medical advice.
notes: Stored only in this browser (localStorage). Print uses the browser print dialog.
